Adalberto Carrasquilla.note: Watch Carrasquilla for creating a better angle for the next pass. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Adalberto Carrasquilla.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Alberto Quintero.note: Quintero stands out for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Alberto Quintero.noteZh: 他的突出特点是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Andres Andrade.note: Watch Andrade for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Andres Andrade.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Anibal Godoy.note: Godoy is defined by organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Anibal Godoy.noteZh: 他靠在危险出现前组织好队友与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Azarias Londono.note: Londoño is defined by pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Azarias Londono.noteZh: 他靠带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑与同位置球员拉开差异。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Carlos Harvey.note: Harvey's edge is creating a better angle for the next pass. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Carlos Harvey.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Cecilio Waterman.note: Waterman stands out for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Cecilio Waterman.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Cesar Blackman.note: Watch Blackman for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Cesar Blackman.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是防线暴露后的回追速度。留意他如何等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Cesar Samudio.note: Watch Samudio for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Cesar Samudio.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是提前站位后的快速反应。留意他如何判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Cesar Yanis.note: Watch Yanis for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Cesar Yanis.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。留意他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Cristian Martinez.note: Martínez's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Cristian Martinez.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Edgar Yoel Barcenas.note: Bárcenas is defined by making purposeful movement away from the ball. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Edgar Yoel Barcenas.noteZh: 他靠用有目的的无球移动创造接应点与同位置球员拉开差异。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Edgardo Farina.note: Watch Fariña for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Edgardo Farina.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Eric Davis.note: Davis stands out for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Eric Davis.noteZh: 他的突出特点是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Fidel Escobar.note: Escobar stands out for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Fidel Escobar.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在危险出现前组织好队友。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Ismael Diaz.note: Díaz stands out for starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Ismael Diaz.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Jiovany Ramos.note: Ramos is defined by the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Jiovany Ramos.noteZh: 他靠在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Jorge Gutierrez.note: Gutiérrez stands out for staying ready through long quiet spells. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Jorge Gutierrez.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Jose Cordoba.note: Watch Córdoba for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Jose Cordoba.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是防线暴露后的回追速度。留意他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Jose Fajardo.note: Fajardo's edge is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Jose Fajardo.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Jose Luis Rodriguez.note: Rodríguez's edge is explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Jose Luis Rodriguez.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Luis Mejia.note: Mejía is defined by organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk.
Luis Mejia.noteZh: 他靠在危险出现前组织好队友与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Michael Murillo.note: Murillo is defined by using strength without slowing the next action. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Michael Murillo.noteZh: 他靠在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Orlando Mosquera.note: Watch Mosquera for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He waits for the strike before committing. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Orlando Mosquera.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是提前站位后的快速反应。留意他如何等到对方触球前再做扑救选择。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Roderick Miller.note: Miller's signature is using strength without slowing the next action. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Roderick Miller.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Tomas Rodriguez.note: Rodríguez's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Tomas Rodriguez.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。
